newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Erciyas to quadruple capital.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Erciyas to quadruple capital.

text.p: Turkish brewer Erciyas Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii A.S. said its executive board decided to distribute three bonuses for one existing share in order to increase its capital to three trillion lira from 750 billion.
In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, the company said it would finance the bonus issue from company reserves.
The increase must be registered by the regulatory Capital Market Board (SPK) before taking effect.
Erciyas had reported net profits of 1.9 trillion lira in the first half of 1996, versus 637 billion in the same 1995 period. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
